what: Austin Energy's Solar Permitting Manual began instructing filers that pre-wire, solar, batteries, spinning generators and wind "should all be separated into their own Auxiliary Power EPs". The permit requirement did not change — its January 2026 revision already covered energy storage — but one project that previously filed a single permit now files several, so permit counts rise without installations rising. The descriptions change with it: system sizes disappear and a single standardised scope dominates.
